housing_notes.value: West Campus Apartments USD 4,530/semester (no meal plan required) or DeGroat Hall USD 4,580 double / USD 5,315 single (requires USD 3,475 meal plan); break housing included free; est books USD 500/sem + est personal USD 2,000/sem (p.3).

host_grants_or_stipends.notes: SUNY Cortland International Award (USD 7,500/yr) applies to full-time degree-seeking students, not short-term tuition-waived exchange.
